The '''Ianane Ring''' was a [[Ring/Legends|ring]]-like structure, the ruins of which [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ianane III]] within the [[Ianane system/Legends|Ianane system]] of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. The surface features of the ring had at some point been reduced to [[Color/Legends|black]] ash, which contrasted with the white color of Ianane III's surface&mdash;the result of [[Star/Legends|sunlight]] reflecting off the deep layer of sand encasing the entire planet. The Ianane Ring was widely believed to be constructed by members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Celestial/Legends|Celestial]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> who had disappeared from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by [[30,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ianane Ring was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the sidebar that would have mentioned the ring was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the structure was later released in [[2013]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Ianane [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the Ianane Ring, in grid square I-10.<ref name="EAOC" />
